name: Matsuura (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Matsuura city emblem in green, blue and red: a green and blue stylised letter S with a red disc.
history: Municipal flag of Matsuura, a city in Nagasaki Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 January 2006.

features.role: Matsuura city emblem — a green and blue stylised letter S with a red disc
